quality.hardDesign: 대조 접속사(while) 앞뒤로 '고도 임계값(4000m)'이라는 조건 단서를 추가해 단순 문법 판단을 넘어 지문의 인과·조건 관계(먼지 반사율 저하→가속 융해, 단 저고도에서만)를 정확히 파악해야 정답을 고를 수 있게 했다. 오답들은 각각 정동사 결여(A, D)와 무관한 원인(바람 패턴, C) 도입, 그리고 so that을 통한 인과관계 전도(A)라는 서로 다른 오개념을 담아 근거 없이는 배제되지 않도록 설계했다.

problem.passage:
Climatologist Renata Vosk spent twelve years analyzing sediment cores from alpine lakes in the Andes. Her data revealed that glacial retreat in the region did not proceed at a steady, gradual pace, as earlier researchers had assumed, but instead accelerated sharply whenever regional dust deposition darkened the ice surface enough to lower its reflectivity past a critical threshold. This finding suggested that dust-driven melting could outweigh temperature increases alone in determining a glacier's retreat rate, a possibility that most prior models had not incorporated. Vosk's conclusion, however, rested on a critical qualification: this dust-accelerated melting pattern appeared only in glaciers situated below four thousand meters in elevation, ______ the higher glaciers examined in the same study retreated at rates matching standard temperature-based predictions with no measurable influence from dust cover.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: Climatologist Renata Vosk spent twelve years analyzing sediment cores from alpine lakes in the Andes. Her data revealed that glacial retreat in the region did not proceed at a steady, gradual pace, as earlier researchers had assumed, but instead accelerated sharply whenever regional dust deposition darkened the ice surface enough to lower its reflectivity past a critical threshold. This finding suggested that dust-driven melting could outweigh temperature increases alone in determining a glacier's retreat rate, a possibility that most prior models had not incorporated. Vosk's conclusion, however, rested on a critical qualification: this dust-accelerated melting pattern appeared only in glaciers situated below four thousand meters in elevation, ______ the higher glaciers examined in the same study retreated at rates matching standard temperature-based predictions with no measurable influence from dust cover.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: so that the higher glaciers in her sample, unaffected by dust deposition, retreating at rates consistent with temperature alone
while the higher glaciers in her sample were unaffected by dust deposition and retreated at rates consistent with temperature alone
and the higher glaciers, unlike the lower ones, depended entirely on wind patterns rather than temperature to determine their retreat
while the higher glaciers in her sample being unaffected by dust deposition and retreating at rates consistent with temperature alone
problem.explanation: 정답은 B. 빈칸은 '4000m 이하 빙하에서만 먼지 가속 융해가 나타났다'는 절과 '더 높은 빙하는 그렇지 않았다'는 대조 절을 연결해야 한다. 접속사 while이 이끄는 절 안에는 완전한 정동사가 필요하다. B는 "while the higher glaciers ... were unaffected ... and retreated ..."로 were와 retreated가 병렬 정동사를 이루어 문법적으로 완결되며, 지문의 고도별 대조(4000m 기준)를 정확히 반영한다. A는 so that 뒤에 분사 retreating만 있고 정동사가 없어 비문이며, so that은 결과를 나타내는 접속사로 앞 문장의 '고도 조건에 따른 대조'라는 논리와 맞지 않는다(인과관계 전도 오개념). C는 and 뒤에 분사 depended만 쓰여 정동사가 없는 비문일 뿐 아니라, 지문에 전혀 언급되지 않은 '바람 패턴'이라는 새로운 원인을 도입해 지문 정보를 벗어난다(근거 없는 정보 추가). D는 while절 안에 being과 retreating이라는 분사만 있고 정동사가 없어 문법적으로 불완전한 종속절이다(정동사 결여 오류, B와 형태는 비슷하나 시제 구조가 다름).
